answer: Best sybil defense: on-ledger slashing of verifiers. Each verifier stakes a bond and countersigns transactions per epoch; anyone caught signing an invalid transaction has stake burned automatically, far above the epoch reward. Fake identities need staked registration, so an attacker building a glacier of counterfeit nodes locks capital per identity, and no cipher trick or hidden grove conceals signed invalid work, since evidence is public and penalties automatic. Corruption means buying dominant stake, which slashing makes unprofitable.
